f.title: Submit unit registration, responsible-person change or deregistration notices by letter

f.clause: 4.1.1.2 Escrito de sometimiento

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote: Para someter cualquiera de los trámites antes mencionados, se deberá entregar un escrito libre en hoja membretada, al CEFV o al CICFV al que la unidad pertenezca, con copia al CNFV, en caso de que la unidad no pertenezcan a un CEFV ni a un CICFV, deberá realizarlo directamente al CNFV a través del Centro Integral de Servicios de la COFEPRIS
rows.location: 4.1.1.2 Escrito de sometimiento

f.title: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance is the only valid interlocutor
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance will be the only valid interlocutor on pharmacovigilance matters.
f.clause: 4.1.1.2 Escrito de sometimiento

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System

rows.quote_en: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance will be the only valid interlocutor in pharmacovigilance matters.

f.title: Show the PV centre or unit in the institution's organisation chart
f.statement: The CICFV, CIFV or UFV shall be included in the institution's general organisation chart, identifying the area to which it belongs.
f.clause: 4.2.2 Organigrama

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote: Se deberá incluir la figura de CICFV, CIFV o UFV del Sistema Nacional de Salud en el organigrama general de la institución e identificar a qué área pertenece.
rows.location: 4.2.2 Organigrama
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Se deberá incluir' = Mandatory; impersonal, institution inferred.
rows.quote_en: The CICFV, CIFV or UFV of the National Health System shall be included in the general organisation chart of the institution, identifying the area to which it belongs.

f.title: Provide the minimum material resources for PV activities
f.statement: To carry out pharmacovigilance activities properly the unit must have physical space, computer equipment, Internet, e-mail, telephone, printer, scanner, filing and stationery.
f.clause: 4.2.3 Recursos materiales

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote: Para poder realizar adecuadamente las actividades de farmacovigilancia se debe contar con lo siguiente:  Espacio físico donde se puedan llevar a cabo las actividades de farmacovigilancia.  Equipo de cómputo.  Internet.  Correo electrónico.  Teléfono.  Impresora.  Escáner.  Archivo.  Material de papelería.
rows.location: 4.2.3 Recursos materiales
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'se debe contar' = Mandatory; impersonal, unit inferred.
rows.quote_en: To carry out pharmacovigilance activities properly the following must be available: physical space where pharmacovigilance activities can be carried out; computer equipment; Internet; e-mail; telephone; printer; scanner; filing; stationery.

f.title: Designate a qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance and keep their identity current
f.statement: Each CICFV, CIFV and UFV shall designate a person responsible for pharmacovigilance with the profile required by current regulation and keep that person's identity up to date with the CNFV, CEFV or CICFV as applicable (NOM-220 numeral 7.4.1.2).
f.clause: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote:  Designar un Responsable de Farmacovigilancia con el perfil en apego a la normatividad vigente.  Mantener actualizado ante el CNFV, el CEFV o el CICFV al que le corresponda, la identidad del Responsable de Farmacovigilancia, de acuerdo con el numeral 7.4.1.2 de la NOM-220-SSA1-2016 (ver diagrama 1).
rows.location: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS

rows.quote_en: Designate a person responsible for pharmacovigilance with the profile required by current regulation. Keep the identity of the person responsible for pharmacovigilance up to date with the CNFV, CEFV or CICFV as applicable, in accordance with numeral 7.4.1.2 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016 (see diagram 1).

f.title: Send ICSRs using ICH-E2B-compliant systems
f.statement: Under NOM-220 numeral 8.1.12.2, notifications of SRAM, EA, RAM, ESAVI or any other safety problem shall be sent using systems that comply with current international pharmacovigilance standards (ICH-E2B).
f.clause: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote: De acuerdo con el numeral 8.1.12.2 de la NOM-220-SSA1-2016, el envío de notificaciones de SRAM, EA, RAM, ESAVI o cualquier otro problema de seguridad relacionado con el uso de los medicamentos, deberá llevarse a cabo utilizando sistemas que se apeguen a los estándares internacionales vigentes para farmacovigilancia (ICH-E2B).
rows.location: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá llevarse a cabo' = Mandatory; impersonal, sender inferred; restates NOM-220 8.1.12.2.
rows.quote_en: In accordance with numeral 8.1.12.2 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016, notifications of SRAM, EA, RAM, ESAVI or any other safety problem related to the use of medicines shall be sent using systems that comply with current international standards for pharmacovigilance (ICH-E2B).

f.title: Send notifications within the NOM-220 numeral 8.1.11 / 8.1.11.1 timelines
f.statement: Notifications shall be sent within the times established in numerals 8.1.11 and 8.1.11.1 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016; the guide does not restate the day counts.

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System

rows.quote: Para el envío de las notificaciones deberán apegarse a los tiempos establecidos en los numerales 8.1.11 y 8.1.11.1 de la NOM-220-SSA1-2016.
rows.location: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS

rows.quote_en: For sending notifications, they shall comply with the times established in numerals 8.1.11 and 8.1.11.1 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016.

f.title: Run a training and reporting-promotion programme and keep evidence
f.statement: Promote notification with emphasis on information quality, and implement a programme of training, dissemination and promotion of pharmacovigilance case reporting, keeping evidence (attendance lists, syllabi and/or certificates, among others).
f.clause: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote:  Fomentar la notificación de SRAM, RAM, ESAVI, EA o cualquier problema de seguridad relacionado con el uso de medicamentos y vacunas, haciendo énfasis en garantizar la calidad de la información.   Implementar un programa de capacitación, difusión y fomento de reporte de casos de farmacovigilancia, por lo que se deberá de tener evidencia de dichas actividades (lista de asistencia, temarios y/o constancias, entre otros).
rows.location: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS

Implement a programme of training, dissemination and promotion of pharmacovigilance case reporting, for which there shall be evidence of these activities (attendance list, syllabi and/or certificates, among others).

f.title: SOP I: receipt and registration of SRAM notifications
f.statement: The receipt and registration SOP shall detail how SRAM notifications will be received and registered.

rows.location: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, I. Recepción y registro de notificaciones de sospecha de RAM

rows.quote: II. Codificación de notificaciones de sospecha de RAM. Se utilizará la codificación definida por el CNFV, la cual está establecida en la Guía de farmacovigilancia para la notificación de EA, SRAM, RAM o cualquier problema de seguridad relacionado con el uso de medicamentos
rows.location: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, II. Codificación de notificaciones de sospecha de RAM

f.title: SOP III: notifier reviews case data against source information
f.statement: It is intended that the notifier review the information of the notified case to validate it against the source information, and may consider patient data, suspect medicine data, SRAM or ESAVI data and notifier data.
f.clause: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, III. Validación de datos

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote: Se pretende que el notificador revise la información del caso notificado para validar con la información fuente, donde puede considerar:  Datos del paciente.  Datos del medicamento sospechoso.  Datos de la SRAM o ESAVI.  Datos del notificador.
rows.location: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, III. Validación de datos

rows.quote_en: It is intended that the notifier review the information of the notified case in order to validate it against the source information, for which they may consider: patient data; suspect medicine data; SRAM or ESAVI data; notifier data.

f.title: SOP IV: pre-assess causality with the Naranjo algorithm (CIFV and CICFV)
f.statement: For causality pre-assessment the Naranjo et al. algorithm is applied, classifying suspected adverse reactions as definite (score 9 or more), probable (5 to 8), possible (1 to 4) or doubtful (0 or less).
f.clause: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, IV. Pre-evaluación de la causalidad de las notificaciones
f.exceptions: Not applicable to UFV of the SNS (Table 2).

rows.actor: CIFV and CICFV
rows.quote: Para la evaluación de la relación causa-efecto, se aplica el algoritmo de Naranjo y sus colaboradores. De acuerdo con el algoritmo, las sospechas de reacciones adversas quedarían clasificadas en las cuatro categorías siguientes: 1) Definida: Cuando al realizar el algoritmo se obtiene una puntuación de 9 o más puntos. 2) Probable: Cuando al realizar el algoritmo se obtiene una puntuación de 5 a 8 puntos. 3) Posible: Cuando al realizar el algoritmo se obtiene una puntuación de 1 a 4 puntos. 4) Dudosa: Cuando al realizar el algoritmo se obtiene una puntuación de 0 o inferior.
rows.location: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, IV. Pre-evaluación de la causalidad de las notificaciones
rows.review_note: Review: no change; 'se aplica' (is applied) read as the prescribed method within the SOP, level Mandatory kept. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'se aplica' (present indicative), no modal verb; Mandatory is a judgement. Removed 'applies only to CIFV and CICFV' from statement (from Table 2, not the quote); the exception field still records it.
rows.quote_en: For the assessment of the cause-effect relationship, the algorithm of Naranjo et al. is applied. According to the algorithm, suspected adverse reactions would be classified in the following four categories: 1) Definite: when the algorithm yields a score of 9 or more points. 2) Probable: score of 5 to 8 points. 3) Possible: score of 1 to 4 points. 4) Doubtful: score of 0 or less.

f.title: SOP V: detect duplicates before sending any notification
f.statement: Before sending any notification, quality control for duplicate detection must be performed; the SOP shall describe the mechanism by which, after reviewing the established notification parameters, duplicate cases will be detected.
f.clause: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, V. Detección de duplicidad de notificaciones

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote: Antes de enviar cualquier notificación, es necesario realizar el control de calidad para la detección de duplicidad, para así evitar el envío de notificaciones duplicadas. Para ello, en este procedimiento se deberá describir el mecanismo a través del cual, tras la revisión de los parámetros de la notificación que se establezcan, se detectará la duplicidad de los casos.
rows.location: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, V. Detección de duplicidad de notificaciones
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'es necesario'/'se deberá describir' = Mandatory; unit inferred.
rows.quote_en: Before sending any notification, it is necessary to carry out quality control for duplicate detection, in order to avoid sending duplicate notifications. To this end, this procedure shall describe the mechanism by which, after review of the established notification parameters, duplicate cases will be detected.

rows.location: 4.3.1.1 PNOs, VIII. Conservación de toda la documentación

f.title: SOP XV: define how internal audits are carried out

rows.quote_en: Define how audits of their internal procedures will be carried out, with the participation of their own UFV.

f.title: Complete and send the CHFV installation record
f.statement: When setting up a CHFV, taking into account the hospital's characteristics and needs, the Record of Installation of the Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (annex 2) shall be completed and sent to the CICFV, CEFV or CNFV as applicable.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 Comité Hospitalario de Farmacovigilancia (CHFV)
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Signal management; Safety governance

rows.actor: Hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV and their Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (CHFV)
rows.quote: Una vez considerado lo anterior, deberá realizar el llenado del Acta de la Instalación del Comité Hospitalario de Farmacovigilancia (anexo 2) y enviarla al CICFV, CEFV o CNFV, según corresponda de acuerdo al diagrama 1.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 Comité Hospitalario de Farmacovigilancia (CHFV)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; quote opens with 'Una vez considerado lo anterior' (missing lead-in); hospital unit inferred.
rows.quote_en: Once the above has been considered, the Record of Installation of the Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (annex 2) shall be completed and sent to the CICFV, CEFV or CNFV, as applicable according to diagram 1.

f.title: Hospital PV units must organise a CHFV and report PV results to it periodically
f.statement: In accordance with NOM-220-SSA1-2016, hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV must organise a Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee that is periodically informed of pharmacovigilance results.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 Comité Hospitalario de Farmacovigilancia (CHFV)
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Signal management; Safety governance

rows.actor: Hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV and their Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (CHFV)
rows.quote: De acuerdo a lo establecido en la NOM-220-SSA1-2016, los CICFV, CIFV y UFV de hospitales deben organizar un Comité Hospitalario de Farmacovigilancia, al cual se le informe periódicamente sobre los resultados de farmacovigilancia.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 Comité Hospitalario de Farmacovigilancia (CHFV)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deben' = Mandatory; actors named; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: In accordance with NOM-220-SSA1-2016, hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV must organise a Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee, which is periodically informed of pharmacovigilance results.

f.title: Create a CHFV organisation chart and position it in the institution
f.statement: Each institution shall create an organisation chart identifying the committee's structure and members, and identify where the CHFV fits in the institution's general chart, defining interactions with other committees (e.g. COFAT, Medicines Committee).
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Organización (Organigrama)
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Signal management; Safety governance

rows.actor: Hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV and their Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (CHFV)
rows.quote: Cada institución deberá crear un organigrama en el que se identifique la estructura del comité y sus integrantes. Además, deberá identificar dónde se integra el Comité Hospitalario de Farmacovigilancia dentro del organigrama general de la institución, definiendo las interacciones con otros comités, tales como el Comité de Farmacia y Terapéutica (COFAT) y el Comité de Medicamentos, entre otros.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Organización (Organigrama)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Cada institución deberá' = Mandatory; actor named; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: Each institution shall create an organisation chart identifying the structure of the committee and its members. In addition, it shall identify where the Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee fits within the general organisation chart of the institution, defining interactions with other committees, such as the Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committee (COFAT) and the Medicines Committee, among others.

f.title: CHFV members must have no conflict of interest with the pharmaceutical sector
f.statement: It is essential that CHFV members have no conflict of interest with the pharmaceutical sector.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Perfil de los miembros del CHFV
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Signal management; Safety governance

rows.actor: Hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV and their Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (CHFV)
rows.quote: Es indispensable que los miembros no tengan conflicto de intereses con el sector farmacéutico,
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Perfil de los miembros del CHFV
rows.review_note: Review: desirable-knowledge part removed from the statement (beyond the quote; now new Recommended row 0047). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Es indispensable' read as Mandatory; quote ends mid-sentence; responsible party for compliance inferred.
rows.quote_en: It is essential that members have no conflict of interest with the pharmaceutical sector,

f.title: All CHFV members sign a no-conflict-of-interest and confidentiality letter at every session
f.statement: All CHFV members shall sign, at every session, the no conflict of interest and confidentiality letter.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Signal management; Safety governance

rows.actor: Hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV and their Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (CHFV)
rows.quote:  Todos los integrantes del CHFV deberán firmar en todas las sesiones que se lleven a cabo, la carta de NO CONFLICTO DE INTERÉS Y CONFIDENCIALIDAD.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberán' = Mandatory; actor (all CHFV members) named; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: All CHFV members shall sign, at every session held, the NO CONFLICT OF INTEREST AND CONFIDENTIALITY letter.

f.title: Hold CHFV sessions periodically and convene extraordinary sessions with at least 48 hours' notice
f.statement: Sessions shall be held periodically according to the institution's annual calendar, convened by the President or Secretary; extraordinary sessions, if required, are convened with at least 48 hours' notice.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Signal management; Safety governance

rows.actor: Hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV and their Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (CHFV)
rows.deadline: Extraordinary sessions: at least 48 hours' notice
rows.quote:  Las sesiones deberán mantener una periodicidad, la cual estará definida de acuerdo al calendario anual de la institución.  Las sesiones serán convocadas por el Presidente o Secretario del CHFV.  En caso de que se requiera, se solicitarán sesiones extraordinarias, convocando a los miembros del CHFV con al menos 48 horas de anticipación.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
rows.review_note: Review: no change; three consecutive bullets on session scheduling kept together. Re-translation: agrees ('se solicitarán' = will be requested; 48 hours notice). Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberán' for periodicity; 'serán convocadas'/'se solicitarán' are future indicative; 48 hours explicit.
rows.quote_en: Sessions shall be held periodically, as defined by the institution's annual calendar. Sessions will be convened by the President or Secretary of the CHFV. If required, extraordinary sessions will be requested, convening the CHFV members at least 48 hours in advance.

f.title: Base the CHFV prior report on scientific evidence with medicine, problem and bibliographic details
f.statement: The prior report presented to the CHFV shall be based on scientific evidence and describe: the medicine (generic name, pharmaceutical form, indication, dose, route, batch, expiry date, manufacturer); the problem identified; and all bibliographic support used.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Signal management; Safety governance

rows.actor: Hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV and their Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (CHFV)
rows.quote:  El informe previo deberá realizarse con base a la evidencia científica y deberá describir los siguientes aspectos:  Medicamento: Nombre genérico, forma farmacéutica, indicación terapéutica, dosis, vía de administración, lote, fecha de caducidad, laboratorio productor.  Problema identificado: Descripción detallada sobre las reacciones adversas, eventos supuestamente atribuibles a la vacunación o inmunización u otros problemas de seguridad con el uso de medicamentos y vacunas que representen un riesgo para los pacientes.  Sustento bibliográfico: Todos los documentos de apoyo que utilizaron.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; author of the prior report inferred.
rows.quote_en: The prior report shall be based on scientific evidence and shall describe the following aspects: Medicine: generic name, pharmaceutical form, therapeutic indication, dose, route of administration, batch, expiry date, manufacturer. Problem identified: detailed description of the adverse reactions, events supposedly attributable to vaccination or immunisation or other safety problems with the use of medicines and vaccines that represent a risk to patients. Bibliographic support: all supporting documents used.

f.title: Document CHFV agreements in minutes with the required attachments
f.statement: CHFV agreements and commitments shall be documented in minutes (institutional format or annex 2 example), attaching the attendance list, agenda, cases presented, agreements, follow-up of agreements (start/close dates), resolution on actions taken, topics for the next session and signatures of all members.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Signal management; Safety governance

rows.actor: Hospital CICFV, CIFV and UFV and their Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (CHFV)
rows.quote:  Documentar las acciones derivadas de los acuerdos y compromisos adquiridos por los miembros a través de un acta; se podrá utilizar la que se tiene de acuerdo a las políticas de su institución o podrá utilizar la que se tiene como ejemplo en el anexo 2 de la presente guía.   Se deberá de anexar:   Lista de asistencia.   Orden del día.   Casos presentados ante el CHFV.   Acuerdos.   Seguimiento de acuerdos (fecha de inicio/fecha de cierre).   Resolución respecto a las acciones tomadas.   Temas a tratar en la próxima sesión.   Firma de todos los integrantes del CHFV.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
rows.review_note: Review: quote extended back to 'Documentar las acciones...' so it proves the minutes duty and the choice of format stated in the statement. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. Infinitive 'Documentar' with 'se podrá'/'Se deberá de anexar'; actor inferred.
rows.quote_en: Document the actions derived from the agreements and commitments made by the members by means of minutes; the institution's own format under its policies may be used, or the example in annex 2 of this guide may be used. The following shall be attached: attendance list; agenda; cases presented to the CHFV; agreements; follow-up of agreements (start date/close date); resolution on actions taken; topics for the next session; signature of all CHFV members.

f.title: Send the CHFV annual report with indicator evidence in January of the following year
f.statement: The CHFV Technical Secretary shall complete the Annual Report of the Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee (annex 3) and send it in January of the following year, with evidence of each indicator, to the CICFV or CEFV as applicable.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV

rows.actor: Technical Secretary of the Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee
rows.quote:  El Secretario Técnico deberá llenar el formato Reporte anual del Comité Hospitalario de Farmacovigilancia (anexo 3).y enviarlo en el mes de enero del año siguiente, junto con la evidencia de cada indicador realizado, al CICFV o CEFV, según corresponda.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; Technical Secretary named; January of the following year explicit.
rows.quote_en: The Technical Secretary shall complete the Annual Report of the Hospital Pharmacovigilance Committee form (annex 3) and send it in January of the following year, together with the evidence of each indicator, to the CICFV or CEFV, as applicable.

f.title: CEFVs consolidate hospital CHFV information and send it to the CNFV in February
f.statement: CEFVs shall consolidate the information received from the hospital Pharmacovigilance Units under them and send to the CNFV, in February of the following year, the Summary of CHFV sessions form (annex 4), the communications generated at each session and evidence of implementation.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos para el envío de información derivada del CHFV

rows.actor: State Pharmacovigilance Centres (CEFV)
rows.quote: Los CEFV deberán realizar el concentrado de la información recibida de las Unidades de Farmacovigilancia de Hospitales a su cargo y enviar al CNFV, en el mes de febrero del año siguiente, el formato Concentrado de sesiones del CHFV (anexo 4) y los comunicados generados de cada sesión, así como la evidencia de la implementación.
rows.location: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos para el envío de información derivada del CHFV
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberán' = Mandatory; CEFV named; February of the following year explicit.
rows.quote_en: The CEFV shall consolidate the information received from the hospital Pharmacovigilance Units under them and send to the CNFV, in February of the following year, the Summary of CHFV sessions form (annex 4) and the communications generated at each session, as well as the evidence of implementation.

f.title: CICFV coordinates its units, acts as sole interlocutor and prepares periodic activity reports
f.statement: The CICFV coordinates the activities of the pharmacovigilance units under it; its responsible person is the only interlocutor with the CNFV and prepares the periodic reports on all PV activities of its UFVs (annex 1).
f.clause: 4.3.2 Actividades particulares (Centros Institucionales Coordinadores de Farmacovigilancia)

rows.actor: Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres (CICFV)
rows.quote:  Coordinar las actividades de las unidades de farmacovigilancia a su cargo. El responsable del CICFV será el único interlocutor ante el CNFV. Realizará los informes periódicos correspondientes a todas las actividades de farmacovigilancia de las UFV a su cargo (anexo 1).
rows.location: 4.3.2 Actividades particulares (Centros Institucionales Coordinadores de Farmacovigilancia)
rows.review_note: Review: no change; three CICFV duties in one bullet kept together (same actor). Re-translation: agrees ('será', 'Realizará' = will/shall). Double-check: Translation verified. Infinitive 'Coordinar' plus future 'será'/'Realizará'; no modal verb; actor from the heading.
rows.quote_en: Coordinate the activities of the pharmacovigilance units under it. The person responsible for the CICFV will be the only interlocutor with the CNFV and will prepare the periodic reports on all pharmacovigilance activities of the UFVs under it (annex 1).

f.title: CICFV and CIFV pre-assess causality of cases received per NOM-220
f.statement: For SRAM, RAM, EA and ESAVI cases received, CICFVs and CIFVs shall perform a causality pre-assessment in accordance with NOM-220-SSA1-2016.
f.clause: 4.3.2 Actividades particulares

rows.actor: CICFV and CIFV
rows.quote:  De los casos recibidos de SRAM, RAM, EA y ESAVI deberá realizar un pre-evaluación de causalidad apegado a lo que establece la NOM-220-SSA1-2016.
rows.location: 4.3.2 Actividades particulares
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'deberá' = Mandatory; CICFV/CIFV from the heading, not the quote.
rows.quote_en: For the SRAM, RAM, EA and ESAVI cases received, it shall perform a causality pre-assessment in accordance with NOM-220-SSA1-2016.

f.title: UFVs without hospital care are exempt from CHFV, SOP and quality-manual activities
f.statement: UFVs of the SNS without hospital care shall comply with all the general activities except those relating to the CHFV, SOPs and quality manual.
f.clause: 4.3.2 Actividades particulares (UFV del SNS sin atención de Hospitalización)
f.exceptions: CHFV, SOPs and quality manual not required for UFVs without hospital care.

rows.actor: UFV of the SNS without hospital care
rows.quote:  Cumplir con todas las actividades generales, excepto lo relativo a CHFV, PNOs y manual de calidad.
rows.location: 4.3.2 Actividades particulares (UFV del SNS sin atención de Hospitalización)
rows.review_note: Review: statement reworded to lead with the quoted duty. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. infinitive bullet under 'Actividades generales'/'particulares' read as Mandatory; actor from the heading, not the quote. Removed the parenthesis on units with hospital care from statement (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: Comply with all general activities, except those relating to the CHFV, SOPs and quality manual.

f.title: CICFVs must have a Quality Assurance System
f.statement: Under NOM-220 numeral 7.3.3, Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres are responsible for having a Quality Assurance System.
f.clause: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad

rows.actor: Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres (CICFV)
rows.quote: De acuerdo con lo establecido en el numeral 7.3.3 de la NOM-220-SSA-2016, es responsabilidad de los Centros Institucionales Coordinadores de Farmacovigilancia contar con un Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad,
rows.location: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad
rows.review_note: Review: no change; source cites 'NOM-220-SSA-2016' [sic]. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'es responsabilidad de ... contar' = Mandatory with CICFV named; quote ends at a comma. Purpose clause removed from statement (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: In accordance with numeral 7.3.3 of NOM-220-SSA-2016 [sic], it is the responsibility of the Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres to have a Quality Assurance System,

f.title: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the QA system
f.statement: Each Institutional Coordinating Centre must establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the Quality Assurance System.
f.clause: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad

rows.actor: Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres (CICFV)
rows.quote: Cada Centro Institucional Coordinador debe establecer, implementar, mantener y mejorar continuamente el Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad.
rows.location: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad
rows.review_note: Review: title trimmed ('with documented information' is row 0040). Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'debe' = Mandatory; actor named; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: Each Institutional Coordinating Centre must establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the Quality Assurance System.

f.title: Maintain documented QA information: quality manual, procedures and records
f.statement: A requirement for establishing the Quality Assurance System is to maintain documented information: the quality manual, the documented procedures and the records derived from them.
f.clause: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad

rows.actor: Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres (CICFV)
rows.quote: Un requisito para establecer el Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad, es mantener la información documentada, dicha información se refiere al manual de calidad, a los procedimientos documentados y a los registros que se deriven de ellos.
rows.location: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Un requisito ... es mantener' (no modal verb); Mandatory is a judgement. Parentheticals on policy/objectives and SOPs removed from statement (not in quote).
rows.quote_en: A requirement for establishing the Quality Assurance System is to maintain documented information; this information refers to the quality manual, the documented procedures and the records derived from them.

f.title: Recommended content of the quality manual
f.statement: The quality manual describes the QA system, its scope and exclusions; it is recommended that it contain a cover page showing who prepared, reviewed and authorised it, among other sections.
f.clause: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Manual de calidad)

rows.actor: Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres (CICFV)
rows.quote: Describe con exactitud el Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad, el alcance y las exclusiones del mismo. Se recomienda que el manual contenga:  Portada. Es la página de presentación del manual, en donde figura; quién elaboró, revisó y autorizó.
rows.location: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Manual de calidad)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Se recomienda' = Recommended; the manual's further sections follow the quote and were removed from statement.
rows.quote_en: It describes precisely the Quality Assurance System and its scope and exclusions. It is recommended that the manual contain: Cover page: the presentation page of the manual, showing who prepared, reviewed and authorised it.

f.title: Set measurable quality objectives and plan how to achieve them
f.statement: The CICFV must establish measurable objectives for its functions and processes, relevant to PV conformity, monitored, communicated and updated; planning must determine what will be done, resources, responsible person, completion date and how results will be evaluated.
f.clause: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Requisitos del Sistema)

rows.actor: Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres (CICFV)
rows.quote: Objetivos: El CICFV debe establecer objetivos para las funciones y los procesos que realiza. Los objetivos deben ser medibles, pertinentes para la conformidad de las actividades de farmacovigilancia, objeto de seguimiento, comunicarse y actualizarse, según corresponda. Para la planificación de cómo lograrán cumplir los objetivos, los CICFV deben determinar qué se va a hacer, qué recursos requerirán, quién será el responsable, cuándo se finaliza y cómo se evaluarán los resultados.
rows.location: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Requisitos del Sistema)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'debe' = Mandatory; CICFV named; statement matches quote.
rows.quote_en: Objectives: the CICFV must establish objectives for the functions and processes it performs. The objectives must be measurable, relevant to the conformity of pharmacovigilance activities, monitored, communicated and updated, as appropriate. When planning how they will meet the objectives, the CICFV must determine what will be done, what resources will be required, who will be responsible, when it will be completed and how the results will be evaluated.

f.title: Establish document-control guidelines for PV documents
f.statement: Document-control guidelines must be established defining the controls needed to approve documents before issue, review and update them when necessary and approve them again, and ensure that changes are identified.
f.clause: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Control de Documentos)

rows.actor: Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres (CICFV)
rows.quote: Control de Documentos: Deben establecerse lineamientos que definan los controles necesarios para: a) Aprobar los documentos antes de su emisión; b) Revisar y actualizar los documentos cuando sea necesario y aprobarlos nuevamente; c) Asegurarse de que se identifican los cambios y el
rows.location: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Control de Documentos)
rows.review_note: Review: no change; clause is cut by a page footer after 'los cambios y el' (items c-g continue on the next page), quote kept verbatim up to the footer. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'Deben establecerse' (impersonal); list cut by a page footer at item c. Statement trimmed to the quoted controls.
rows.quote_en: Document control: guidelines must be established defining the controls needed to: a) approve documents before issue; b) review and update documents when necessary and approve them again; c) ensure that changes and the [current revision status are identified]

f.title: Review and update the quality manual continually, with change control
f.statement: The quality manual must be reviewed continually and updated for any change in activities, regulation, CICFV structure or any aspect affecting its operation, including change control.
f.clause: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Revisión del manual)

rows.actor: Institutional Coordinating Pharmacovigilance Centres (CICFV)
rows.quote: Revisión del manual: Este apartado refiere que el manual debe revisarse continuamente y actualizarse conforme a cualquier modificación de las actividades, de la normatividad establecida, cambios en la estructura del CICFV o bien, algún aspecto que influya en la operación del mismo. Además, en este apartado también se incluye el control de cambios.
rows.location: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Revisión del manual)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: Translation verified. 'debe revisarse' = Mandatory; impersonal, CICFV inferred.
rows.quote_en: Review of the manual: this section states that the manual must be reviewed continually and updated in line with any modification of activities, established regulation, changes in the structure of the CICFV or any aspect affecting its operation. This section also includes change control.

f.title: Participate in pharmacovigilance studies approved by the CNFV
f.statement: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the SNS shall participate in the pharmacovigilance studies approved by the CNFV.
f.clause: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS
f.processes: Epidemiology / safety studies; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the National Health System
rows.quote:  Participar en los estudios de farmacovigilancia aprobados por el CNFV
rows.location: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS

rows.quote_en: Participate in the pharmacovigilance studies approved by the CNFV

f.title: Have a procedures manual that ensures performance of the PV activities
f.statement: CICFV, CIFV and UFV of the SNS shall have a procedures manual that ensures performance of the actions described.
f.clause: 4.3.1 Actividades generales para el CICFV, el CIFV y la UFV del SNS

f.title: Obtain CHFV case information from patient records and interviews
f.statement: Sources of information on cases of adverse reactions, medication errors and therapeutic ineffectiveness shall be obtained from patient records (clinical files, nursing notes, pharmacotherapeutic profile if available, laboratory results) and from interviews with the patient and relatives where applicable, to obtain complete data for the prior report.
f.clause: 4.3.1.2 CHFV, Lineamientos que debe seguir el CHFV

f.title: CICFV PV responsible sets and maintains a quality policy with PV-specific objectives
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance of the CICFV shall establish, implement and maintain a quality policy appropriate to its purpose that provides a framework for quality objectives and includes commitments to meet requirements and to continual improvement; the hospital's quality policy may be used, but specific objectives must be set for pharmacovigilance activities.
f.clause: 4.3.2.1 Sistema de Aseguramiento de la Calidad (Requisitos del Sistema)

rows.quote: debe establecer, implementar y mantener una política de calidad que sea apropiada al propósito y lo apoye, proporcione un marco de referencia para el establecimiento de los objetivos de calidad, incluya el compromiso de cumplir con los requisitos e incluya el compromiso de mejora continua. Se puede utilizar la política de calidad de los hospitales, sin embargo, deben establecerse objetivos específicos para las actividades de farmacovigilancia.
